mapper.select: select to_char(n.closed_at at time zone #{zone}, 'YYYY-MM') as month, case when n.source = 'CLAIM' then 'EXTERNAL' else 'INTERNAL' end as category, case when n.src_type = 'WMS_CUST_RTN' then 'RTN_' else 'NCR_' end || d.disp_type as source, n.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, n.unit_cd, p.std_price, sum(d.qty) as qty, count(*)::int as line_cnt, string_agg(distinct n.ncr_no, ',' order by n.ncr_no) as ncr_nos from qms_ncr n join qms_ncr_disp d on d.ncr_id = n.ncr_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = n.item_id left join lateral (select h.std_price from mst_item_price_hist h where h.item_id = n.item_id and h.changed_at <= n.closed_at order by h.changed_at desc, h.hist_id desc limit 1) p on true where n.status = 'CLOSED' and n.closed_at >= #{fromAt} and n.closed_at < #{toAt} and d.disp_type in ('SCRAP', 'REWORK', 'SORT') group by 1, 2, 3, n.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, n.unit_cd, p.std_price order by 1, 2, 3, i.item_cd, p.std_price nulls last

select i.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.unit_cd, to_char(m.month_start, 'YYYY-MM') as month, p.std_price from mst_item i cross join generate_series(#{from}::date, #{to}::date, interval '1 month') m(month_start) left join lateral (select h.std_price from mst_item_price_hist h where h.item_id = i.item_id and h.changed_at < ((m.month_start + interval '1 month')::timestamp at time zone #{zone}) order by h.changed_at desc, h.hist_id desc limit 1) p on true where i.item_id in #{x}
mapper.sql: c.cost_id, to_char(c.cost_month, 'YYYY-MM') as cost_month, c.category, c.cost_item, c.amount, c.note, c.row_ver, c.updated_at, c.updated_by
mapper.select: select from qms_copq_cost c where c.cost_month >= #{from} and c.cost_month < #{to} order by c.cost_month, c.category, c.cost_id
select from qms_copq_cost c where c.cost_id = #{id}

insert into qms_copq_cost (comp_cd, cost_month, category, cost_item, amount, note, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.costMonth}, #{f.category}, #{f.costItem}, #{f.amount}, #{f.note}, #{by}, #{by}) returning cost_id
mapper.delete: delete from qms_copq_cost where cost_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{rowVer}
